title: explainer diagrams/timeline data
description: A horizontal axis with one node per milestone, labels alternating above/below. Validated by render.mjs against the same built-ins-only subset lib/schema.mjs interprets — see core/diagrams/timeline/README.md.

title.description: Diagram <title>, for accessibility; falls back to "Timeline".

entries.description: Milestones, drawn left to right in array order; labels alternate above (even index) / below (odd index).

date.description: Short muted annotation, shown nearer the axis than detail.

detail.description: Longer muted annotation, shown farthest from the axis.

new.description: Draws the node with the shared "new" class instead of "same". Takes precedence over "changed" if both are set.

changed.description: Draws the node with the shared "changed" class instead of "same".

panel.description: A contents.json page panels[].key; makes the entry a clickable node.
